title: Highlife
tagline: West African dance music built around bright guitars, horns, and elegant grooves.
summary: Highlife developed in Ghana and Nigeria through the meeting of local rhythms with brass-band, guitar, and popular dance music traditions. Its melodic guitar lines and buoyant arrangements spread across West Africa, with artists shaping distinctive regional forms. Highlife remains an important influence on modern African popular music.

pillars.name: E. T. Mensah
pillars.why: Mensah helped popularize Ghanaian dance-band highlife and became known as a major bandleader.

pillars.name: Ebo Taylor
pillars.why: Taylor connected Ghanaian highlife with jazz and funk through decades of composing, performing, and arranging.

pillars.name: Victor Olaiya
pillars.why: Olaiya was a leading Nigerian bandleader whose trumpet-driven highlife recordings became widely celebrated.
